# Kamran Azari

> Personal website and blog of Kamran Azari, a software developer based in the Netherlands, writing about software, IoT and side projects.

## Blog posts

- [Departure Timer: a Chrome Extension That Tells You When to Leave for Your Train](https://kamran.azari.info/blogs/departure-timer): Departure Timer is a free, open source Chrome extension for Dutch train commuters. It shows how many minutes are left before you must leave, using the NS API.
- [Building a Smart Train Departure Countdown Display with ESP32](https://kamran.azari.info/blogs/departure-countdown): How I built a wall-mounted MAX7219 LED display on an ESP32-S3 that counts down to when you need to leave home — not when the train departs — using the NS Dutch Railways API, FreeRTOS, and a local web UI.

## Pages

- [Kamran Azari - Blog](https://kamran.azari.info/blogs): Blog posts by Kamran Azari on software, hardware, and side projects.
- [Kamran Azari - Tools](https://kamran.azari.info/tools): Tools and side projects by Kamran Azari, including a smart train departure countdown display.
- [Kamran Azari - Contact Me](https://kamran.azari.info/contact): Get in touch with Kamran Azari on LinkedIn, GitHub, Stack Overflow or X.
- [Kamran Azari - About Me](https://kamran.azari.info/about): About Kamran Azari: a software developer in the Netherlands who has been building for the web since 2007, mostly with PHP, Python and Go.
